faq: Can you open the account for me?
You open it, because Amazon verifies your identity, tax and bank details and these must be yours. We guide each screen, and then you add us as a user with the permissions the work needs.
What about gated categories and brands?
Some categories and brands need approval from Amazon. We explain what is required and prepare your documents list, but approval is Amazon's decision and we cannot promise it.
Can you get my account verified faster?
No one can. Verification takes the time Amazon needs. We make sure your documents are clear, complete and matching, so the first attempt is less likely to be rejected.
Do I need a registered business?
Not always. Amazon has individual and professional plans, and the right one depends on how much you plan to sell. We explain the difference, and the fees on each, before you choose.
